resources.string: Self-learning
Self-learning
Checks its own readings

OpenStrap looks for readings that cannot be true, such as Energy stuck at zero all afternoon. When it finds one it adjusts its calculation a little, within safe limits, and tells you. Every adjustment fades after two weeks unless the problem shows again, and you can undo it here. Nothing stored is ever changed.
